$comment: How the region's map uses real-time data (apps/server/README.md#real-time-service); how often its feed is polled is the feed's (feed.json → realtime). Copied from Metro Vancouver's, where prediction was tuned on TransLink's 99 and RapidBus; untested here (OPEN-QUESTIONS #3).
$clientPollS: The browser polls the live endpoint (GET /regions/<id>/live/transit) at most this often; it is also the endpoint's longest edge-cache time. Guess.
$clientPollMaxS: ...and at least this often, even when the server expects no new data sooner (its nextAt). Guess.
$clientPollSlackS: The browser polls this long after the server's nextAt, so the poll or AIS batch it waits for has landed. A positions poll usually answers within 1-3 s (guess).
$detourNearM: A bus off its route counts as on detour only within this distance of a stop a detour alert for its route lists (guess, as Metro Vancouver's; OPEN-QUESTIONS #3).
$prediction: Live bus prediction and learned travel-time profiles (packages/transit-core/src/rt/profile.ts): Metro Vancouver's settings, untested on BC Transit's buses (OPEN-QUESTIONS #3).
$carry: Carrying RT bus delays into schedule estimates (packages/transit-core/src/rt/carry.ts): Metro Vancouver's guesses (OPEN-QUESTIONS #3).
